# Maintenance Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MaintenanceStatus`](gmeow-MaintenanceStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MaintenanceStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The maintenance status of a software project — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Answers the question 'is this maintained?' Standpoint-scoped: one community may judge a project abandoned while another considers it stable ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
